# ComplyEasyAI

> ComplyEasyAI is an AI compliance automation platform.
> Read-only integrations collect audit evidence continuously, agents monitor controls and
> propose fixes with human approval for high-impact changes, and each control is mapped once
> across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and the EU AI Act.

Frameworks listed are standards the platform helps customers prepare for, not certifications
held by ComplyEasyAI. Pricing is quoted per framework mix (four annual plans; see /pricing).
Last updated: 2026-09-27

## Key facts

- Frameworks: 16 in-depth framework guides (listed below) and 150+ frameworks and standards in the in-app catalogue.
- Integrations: 26 verified integrations, meaning the credential is checked with the provider at connect time and evidence is collected on sync: AWS, Microsoft Azure, DigitalOcean, Heroku, Kubernetes, Okta, Google Workspace, BambooHR, ADP, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, CircleCI, CrowdStrike, Qualys, Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Zendesk, Asana, Monday.com, Confluence, Slack, Discord, SendGrid and Twilio.
- Pricing: four annual plans (Foundation, Essentials, Growth, Visionary); each is a tailored quote per framework mix and team size. No list prices are published.
- Trials: available on request through the demo form (/demo).
- ComplyEasyAI's own security: SOC 2 Type I audit in progress; no SOC 2 report or ISO 27001 certificate is held yet. Controls in place: encryption at rest (Supabase and AWS), TLS encryption in transit, multi-factor authentication, audit logging, and hosting in a single US region (AWS and Supabase, us-east-1).
- Developer access: REST and GraphQL APIs are available. SDKs (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Java), a CLI, a Terraform provider and a no-code Integration Builder are on the roadmap.
- Available on request (agreed per contract): uptime SLAs with service credits, on-premises deployment, 24/7 phone support, a dedicated customer success manager, professional and managed services including a virtual CISO, migration help, and audit bundling with partner audit firms.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.complyeasyai.com/): what ComplyEasyAI does, on one page.
- [Platform](https://www.complyeasyai.com/platform): the aCOS loop (observe, predict, act, verify, learn), the Compliance Digital Twin and safe remediation.
- [Pricing](https://www.complyeasyai.com/pricing): Foundation, Essentials, Growth and Visionary plans.
- [Frameworks](https://www.complyeasyai.com/frameworks): all 16 framework guides.
- [FAQ](https://www.complyeasyai.com/faq): pricing, frameworks, AI, security, integrations and support.
- [Book a demo or request a trial](https://www.complyeasyai.com/demo): a 30-minute walkthrough tailored to your frameworks.
